name: How does Hometelligent Inc. handle project management for home office additions?

mainEntity.name: How does Hometelligent Inc. handle project management for home office additions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hometelligent Inc. assigns a dedicated project manager to each home office addition. This manager coordinates all aspects of the project, from initial design review and permitting to subcontractor scheduling and final walk-through. They serve as your primary point of contact, ensuring clear communication and timely updates throughout the construction process. This integrated approach simplifies the experience for our clients.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hometelligent Inc. assigns a dedicated project manager to oversee all project aspects, acting as the main point of contact for clients.
